newsitem.title: USA: First Defiance to buy back shares.
newsitem.headline: First Defiance to buy back shares.

text.p: First Defiance Financial Corp said it plans to repurchase up to five percent of its outstanding shares in the open market over the next six months, beginning November 8.
The shares will be purchased at prevailing market prices from time to time depending on market conditions.

It said the board approved the buybacks in view of the current price level of its common stock and the strong capital position of the company. It said management believes repurchasing shares is an attractive investment opportunity which will benefit First Defiance and its stockholders.
The repurchased shares will become treasury shares available for general corporate purposes, including the issuance of shares in connection with the exercise of stock options.
First Defiance completed a previous five percent repurchase program on September 11.
